posting: About DataNode

DataNode is building the intelligence layer for event risk. Our engine combines prediction-market, financial and real-world data to identify emerging risks, quantify their impact and evaluate potential hedges for funds and trading firms. We are backed by Y Combinator (W27).
The role

Quantitative Researchers at DataNode research and build the models at the center of our intelligence engine. These models estimate the probability of real-world events and their effect on prices. They learn from prediction-market, financial and real-world data, and they are tested on historical data before they reach a client.

As a Quantitative Researcher Intern, you take research from a first idea to a tested model. You work directly with the founders and our quantitative developers, and your results go into a live product.
Key responsibilities
Research, build and validate models that estimate the probability of real-world events and their effect on prices
Apply statistics, machine learning and stochastic calculus
Combine models built on different sources into a single calibrated forecast
Define, with our quantitative developers, the training and test sets that the models need
Design and run rigorous backtests on historical events, and benchmark the results against prediction markets
Translate model output into risk measures for client positions
Follow new research and turn promising ideas into tested code
Qualifications

Current student or recent graduate of an MSc or PhD program in statistics, machine learning, applied mathematics, physics, econometrics or a related quantitative field. Exceptional BSc candidates are welcome
Fluency in Python
Experience with time series foundation models on real data
A rigorous approach to out-of-sample testing
Clear written and verbal communication
Preferred qualifications
Experience trading on prediction markets
Results in forecasting, trading or data science competitions
A thesis or paper on time series forecasting, event modelling or risk modelling
Experience in C++ or Rust
What we offer
A paid, full-time internship. Strong performance can lead to a full-time role with equity
For exceptional performers, a path to a founding leadership role in research
Research that goes into a live product and reaches clients
Direct work with founders who traded prediction markets and built the systems behind it
Program details
Location: Remote in the United States, or in person with the team in San Francisco
Start date: December 14, 2026. We are flexible around exam schedules, and a start in early January 2027 is possible
Duration: 6 months, full-time
Compensation: the monthly base salary for this role is 7,000 to 12,000 USD, based on degree level and experience
How to apply
Apply on Handshake with your CV. Include one piece of work that shows how you think: a thesis, a paper, a notebook or a competition result. Questions go to hiring@datanodelabs.com.
DataNode is an equal opportunity employer.
